notes: Prototype presentation only, no game-rule effect. The player picks one backdrop on Finishing Touches (Portrait); it is drawn behind a portrait's transparent characterImage and saved as identity.backdrop { id, name }. Characters with none (saved before the choice existed) show the default.

Starship Bridge is designer art (256 x 320). The others are placeholders (scripts/makePortraitBackdrops.mjs, 480 x 600). Every backdrop is scaled to the portrait's size when composited. Replace a file to swap the art; the id is the file name.
